positions.statement: In an October 2024 KOIN candidate questionnaire (published under the name Kent Landgraver) for Portland City Council District 3, Landgraver names homelessness, addiction and policing as the biggest problem and proposes the mayor declare an emergency.
positions.excerpt: I propose the mayor declares an emergency, mobilize a whole government response

positions.statement: In the same October 2024 KOIN questionnaire, Landgraver says he would like to see less homelessness and more mental health services in his district.
